item.title: PHP Threat Is Likely Far From Over, Despite Limited Exploitation So Far: GuidePoint Expert
item.description: The threat of attackers potentially exploiting a pair of critical-severity PHP vulnerabilities could persist for some time, even though the initial evidence of exploitation of the PHP2Shell flaws appears to be modest, according to a threat intelligence expert at GuidePoint Security.

item.title: SentinelOne CEO Tomer Weingarten On Autonomous SOC AI: ‘We’re Well Ahead’
item.description: SentinelOne’s progress in bringing autonomous, AI-powered security operations to thousands of customers is giving the company a major ‘technology edge’ over competitors—and is proving the real-world growth opportunities available to partners, SentinelOne CEO Tomer Weingarten tells CRN.
